players.product: leading-edge wafer fab (N3/N2 GAA logic dies)

quarterly_data.signal: 20-F customer concentration (customers named only by letter): Customer A accounted for 19% of TSMC's 2025 net revenue (NT$726,974.3 million; 12% in 2024) and Customer B for 17% (NT$645,178.7 million; 22% in 2024 and 25% in 2023); Customer C was 11% in 2023. TSMC's ten largest customers accounted for approximately 70%, 76% and 78% of net revenue in 2023, 2024 and 2025; its largest customer was 25%, 22% and 19% and its second largest 11%, 12% and 17% in those years.
quarterly_data.figure: 2025: Customer A 19%, Customer B 17%; ten largest customers 78% of net revenue (76% in 2024)

quarterly_data.signal: 20-F revenue detail for 2025 in NT dollars: High Performance Computing net revenue NT$2,192,931 million (58%), up from NT$1,476,891 million (51%) in 2024; smartphone NT$1,110,816 million (29%), Internet of Things NT$191,047 million (5%), automotive NT$186,667 million (5%). By customer headquarters, North America was NT$2,875,270 million (75%, up from 70% in 2024) and China NT$327,503 million (9%). Wafer revenue was NT$3,272,553.5 million, of which 3-nanometer NT$794,341.4 million (NT$459,530.2 million in 2024) and 5-nanometer NT$1,179,907.2 million. Wafer (12-inch equivalent) shipment was 15,022 in 2025 versus 12,910 in 2024 (unit per the filing's footnote).
